scope: Conductor-based positive-sequence engineering estimates for documented added overhead circuits; no fitting to observed interface flows.

source_identity_levels.F84: Project design names bundled Mallard 795 ACSS. The catalog provides the same code word, size and family (30/19 stranding). Installed manufacturer, exact core grade/coating, tested resistance and final as-built geometry are not independently certified.
source_identity_levels.CT_398: Project evidence identifies single 2156 ACSS per phase. Bluebird/ACSS 84/19 is a compatible manufacturer family/size; the NY design's Bluebird transition description corroborates the code family but does not identify the installed manufacturer.
source_identity_levels.Dover_NY_section: Documented twin 795 ACSS and the adjacent reconductored Mallard section support a section-specific candidate. Do not extend the NY twin conductor across the CT single-2156 section.
source_identity_levels.old_Hawk_Drake_Cardinal_ACSR: Existing compact-model templates explicitly identify themselves as synthetic surrogates. R-matched effective length does not prove surveyed route length or installed conductor.

resistance.temperature: Use the same-family manufacturer AC values and piecewise-linear interpolation within their temperature range. Mallard ACSS 95 C and 180 C are interpolated between catalog 75 C and 200 C values; they are not manufacturer test points.
resistance.units: ohm/kft divided by 304.8 gives ohm/m. A mile is 1609.344 m. Do not treat ohm/kft as ohm/km or DC20 as AC operating resistance.
uncertainties: conductor path length versus plan-view route

inductive_reactance.reference_warning: The catalog's one-foot inductive-reactance value is only a reference-spacing term. Multiplying that entry by route length does not incorporate actual phase spacing or bundling.
inductive_reactance.source: PowerWorld TransLineCalc Version 2, printed pages 13-14 (PDF pages 15-16).
limitations: no mutual coupling to adjacent circuits
PAR/transformer leakage and series compensation require separate devices and source data

capacitance_and_B.no_ground_images: C1_per_m = 2*pi*epsilon0 / ln(GMD/r_cap_bundle); r_cap_bundle = diameter/2 for single or sqrt((diameter/2)*bundle_spacing) for twin.
capacitance_and_B.ground_images: Pii=ln(2*hi/r_cap_bundle)/(2*pi*epsilon0); Pij=ln(Dimage_ij/Dij)/(2*pi*epsilon0). The estimator averages potential coefficients under transposition and uses their positive-sequence mode. Detailed untransposed capacitance and grounded shield wires are outside this approximation.
capacitance_and_B.unit_mapping: B_total_siemens=2*pi*f*C1_per_m*length_m. MATPOWER B_pu=B_total_siemens*Zbase and is the TOTAL charging; divide by two only when constructing each nominal-pi terminal shunt.
capacitance_and_B.radius_warning: Capacitance uses physical conductor radius, not the inductive GMR.
sources: EPRI OpenDSS-C General/LineConstants.cpp lines 107-127 for image-potential geometry

base_and_current.rating_conversion: MVA=sqrt(3)*line_to_line_kV*total_phase_bundle_current_A/1000. Do not multiply by the bundle count again.
base_and_current.rating_limit: A catalog ampacity under reference weather is not a project operating limit; conductor, sag, clearance, connectors, terminal equipment and operating duration can constrain the actual circuit.

circuit_and_section_accounting.explicit_circuit_rows: Preserve one physical circuit per source row unless independent evidence establishes a different aggregation. Do not infer multiplicity from R alone.
circuit_and_section_accounting.mixed_sections: Retain different NY/CT conductor sections and their own lengths/geometries. Summing sectional R/X/B is a stated nominal-pi approximation; a distributed ABCD cascade is needed when its approximation error matters.
circuit_and_section_accounting.R_only_matching: Length, temperature, bundle count, circuit count and conductor family can compensate for one another. Ranking candidates by resistance is inferential and cannot certify identity.

exclusions.underground_RCC: Do not assign ACSR/ACSS or apply overhead IEEE-738-style cooling. Need cable conductor/insulation geometry, AC resistance, capacitance, metallic screen/sheath, bonding, installation and soil/duct thermal information.
exclusions.transformers_PAR: Voltage-changing or transformer/PAR records are equipment, not overhead conductors. Never convert a current on one voltage side with the other side's nominal voltage.
exclusions.Schur_equivalents: Reduced equivalent edges are not literal routes or conductors and cannot acquire a physical ampacity from equivalent R/X.

validation.independent_tests: test_line_physics.py checks asymmetric potential-matrix mode, phase permutation, infinite-height limit, physical-radius versus GMR separation, single/twin resistance, temperature interpolation, length/frequency/base scaling, total-B terminal splitting and real-power loss closure.
validation.scientific_limit: Passing engineering identities establishes implementation consistency for the declared assumptions, not as-built circuit certification.
